Aeroplan® Card
Offer Details
Offers may vary depending on where you apply, for example online or in a branch, and can change over time. To take advantage of this particular offer now, apply through the method provided in this advertisement. Review offer details before you apply.
This credit card is not available to either (i) current cardmembers of the Chase Aeroplan Card, or (ii) previous cardmembers of the Chase Aeroplan Card who received a new cardmember bonus for this credit card within the last 24 months.
New Cardmember Bonus – 60,000 Points: To qualify, you must make $3,000 in purchases during the first 3 months from account opening. After qualifying, please allow 6 to 8 weeks for bonus to post to your account. To be eligible for this bonus offer, your credit card account must be open and not in default at the time of fulfillment. Purchases are when you, or an authorized user, use a card to make purchases of products and services. However, the following types of transactions won’t count as purchases: balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like transactions including, but not limited to: travelers checks, foreign currency, money orders, wire transfers, cryptocurrency, other similar digital or virtual currency and other similar transactions; lottery tickets, casino gaming chips, race track wagers, or similar offline and online betting transactions; person-to-person money transfers and account-funding transactions that transfer currency, any checks that access your account, interest, unauthorized or fraudulent charges, and fees of any kind, including an annual fee, if applicable.
Aeroplan 50% Bonus Card Acquisition Offer (this “Offer”): Earn 50% bonus Aeroplan points (“Bonus Points”) on categories that normally earn 1x points (“Eligible Spend”) for the first 2 months from account opening (“Eligible Period”)– up to 20,000 Bonus Points maximum. The following categories won’t earn the 50% Bonus Points: purchases made with Air Canada directly, on travel, at gas stations, grocery stores, or dining at restaurants, including takeout and eligible delivery services. This Offer is available for any individual who has never held an Aeroplan credit card, of any type in either the United States or Canada, regardless of card issuer. For important information about Chase rewards categories, see chase.com/RewardsCategoryFAQsOpens in a new window. This Offer is non-transferable and is not redeemable for cash. Authorized user spend is counted towards the Eligible Spend, and Bonus Points will be awarded to the primary cardmember’s Aeroplan account. “Purchases” do not include balance transfers, cash advances, travelers checks, foreign currency, money orders, wire transfers or similar cash-like transactions, lottery tickets, casino gaming chips, race track wagers or similar betting transactions, any checks that access your account, interest, unauthorized or fraudulent charges, and fees of any kind, including an annual fee, if applicable. Returned items, refunds, rebates, or other similar credits will reduce or cancel the Aeroplan points earned by the amount originally charged to the Card Account.
Bonus Points will be awarded up to 12 weeks from the end of the Eligible Period, (the “Offer Fulfillment Date”). Points awarded to the primary cardmember as part of a welcome bonus offer are excluded from the calculation of bonus points under this Offer. Bonus Points earned with this Offer are not eligible for Everyday Status Qualification (EDQ). Only purchases posted to your Card Account with a transaction date within the Eligible Period will count towards this Offer. Your Card Account and Aeroplan account must be open, and in good standing at the time the Bonus Points are awarded. This Offer cannot be combined with any other offer unless otherwise indicated. This Offer may be changed, withdrawn or extended at any time. This Offer may be revoked by Aeroplan if you appear to be manipulating or abusing it, or are engaged in any suspicious or fraudulent activity, as determined by Aeroplan in its sole discretion. For Aeroplan terms and conditions, please visit: aircanada.com/Aeroplan-termsandconditionsOpens overlay.
$100 Air Canada Annual Credit
A statement credit will be automatically applied to your account for qualifying Air Canada purchases made using your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan credit card up to a maximum accumulation of $50 in statement credits from January 1 through June 30 and up to $50 from July 1 through December 31, for a total maximum accumulation of $100 in statement credits each calendar year. Calendar year means January 1 through December 31 of that same year. Qualifying Air Canada purchases are made using your card with Air Canada directly. Purchases of gift cards; car rentals, hotel bookings, and other third-party partner products and services that can be purchased through aircanada.comOpens overlay; and onboard Wi-Fi are excluded. Air Canada tickets purchased through travel agencies, discount travel sites, vacation clubs, tour operators, or tickets booked as part of a travel package offered by non-airline merchants will not qualify. To qualify for the statement credit offer, account must be open and not in default at the time of fulfillment. Statement credits will be issued for the period in which qualifying purchases post to your account. Please note that processing delays can cause qualifying purchases made during one statement credit period to be allocated to the next period. Please allow 6 to 8 weeks for statement credit(s) to post to your account. Chase may reverse statement credits if an eligible purchase is returned, canceled, or modified or if you close your account within 90 days of receiving a statement credit. Offer is not transferable. Chase and Air Canada reserve the right, in their sole discretion, to prevent, cancel, reconcile, or otherwise refuse to honor any transaction related to this statement credit offer if they suspect there has been fraudulent activity related to the transaction.
Earning in the Rewards Program: You’ll earn points on purchases of products and services, minus returns or refunds, made with a Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card by you or an authorized user of the account; however, the following types of transactions won’t count as purchases and won’t earn points: balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like transactions including, but not limited to: travelers checks, foreign currency, money orders, wire transfers, cryptocurrency, other similar digital or virtual currency and other similar transactions; lottery tickets, casino gaming chips, race track wagers, or similar offline and online betting transactions; person-to-person money transfers and account-funding transactions that transfer currency, any checks that access your account, interest, unauthorized or fraudulent charges, and fees of any kind, including an annual fee, if applicable. 3 points (“3X points”): You’ll earn 3 points for each $1 spent on purchases made with Air Canada® directly. Purchases of gift cards; car rentals, hotel bookings, and other third-party partner products and services that can be purchased through aircanada.comOpens Overlay; and onboard Wi-Fi are excluded. Air Canada tickets purchased through travel agencies, discount travel sites, vacation clubs, tour operators, or tickets booked as part of a travel package offered by non-airline merchants will not qualify. You’ll also earn 3 points for each $1 spent on purchases made in any of the following rewards categories: travel, but excluding purchases made with Air Canada directly that qualify for the 3 points as described above; grocery stores; and dining at restaurants including takeout and eligible delivery services. Grocery store and dining rewards category purchases that post to your account by December 31, 2026 will qualify for earning 3 points for each $1 spent. After that, these purchases will start earning 2 points for each $1 spent. 2 points (“2X points”): You’ll earn 2 points for each $1 spent on purchases made in the following rewards category: gas stations. 1 point (“1X points”): You’ll earn 1 point for each $1 spent on all other purchases. Information about earning/transferring points to Aeroplan: Points will be automatically transferred to Aeroplan after the end of each billing cycle. Points expiration: The points transferred to your Aeroplan Program account won’t expire as long as your card account is open. If your card account is closed, the expiration of points earned in this program that are transferred to your Aeroplan Program account will be governed by the Aeroplan Program General Terms and ConditionsOpens Overlay, available on Air Canada’s website. Losing points: You’ll immediately lose all points that haven’t been transferred to Aeroplan if your card account status changes, or your card account is closed for program misuse, fraudulent activities, or other reasons described in the terms of the Rewards Program Agreement. For important information about Chase rewards categories, see chase.com/RewardsCategoryFAQsOpens in a new window. For more information about the Chase Air Canada Aeroplan card rewards program, you can see the latest Rewards Program Agreement at chase.com/aircanada/rewardsagreementOpens in a new window and it will also be available for cardmembers after logging in to chase.comOpens in a new window and will be mailed for new or changed accounts.
Earning points from Air Canada: Earn 2 Aeroplan points per dollar spent on Eligible Air Canada flights or Star Alliance flights booked with Air Canada (ticket number starting with 014). Aeroplan members who are primary cardmembers, earn 1 point per dollar, and 1 extra point per dollar is awarded for holding Aeroplan 25K status at the time of travel. Points are earned based on the base fare and carrier surcharges of the Eligible Scheduled Flight in Canadian dollars (CAD) excluding applicable taxes, fees, and third-party charges. The primary cardmember’s Aeroplan number must be appended to the booking to earn Aeroplan points. For details see https://www.aircanada.com/ca/en/aco/home/aeroplan/status/tiers.html#/Opens overlay. Chase is not responsible for the provision of, or failure to provide, points earned from Air Canada under the Aeroplan program. Points earned from Air Canada under the Aeroplan program will be earned in accordance with the rules of the Aeroplan program. For details see https://www.aircanada.com/ca/en/aco/home/aeroplan/earn.html#/Opens overlay. Points will post directly to your Aeroplan account within 2-4 weeks post flight completion and will not appear on your credit card statement.
Aeroplan 25K Status
You, as the primary cardmember, will receive Aeroplan 25K Status when your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card account is opened and up until the account is closed. If you have earned a higher status by other means (in accordance with Air Canada’s Aeroplan Elite Status Terms and Conditions), you will retain the higher status. Aeroplan 25K Status and access to all associated features, benefits, services and amenities are subject to the Terms and Conditions of the Aeroplan Elite Status program and are available at aircanada.com/elite-termsandconditionsOpens Overlay. Aeroplan 25K Status is non transferrable. Your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card account must be linked to your Aeroplan number and must be open and not in default to receive and retain Aeroplan 25K Status. Chase is not responsible for the provision of, or failure to provide, the stated benefits.
FLY15OFF
Primary Aeroplan® Cardmembers of eligible Aeroplan co-brand cards whose cards are linked with their Aeroplan account (“Cardmembers”) will receive a reduction of at least 15% on the Aeroplan points required to redeem for the base fare of eligible flight rewards, as compared to the number of points required to book the same itinerary by an Aeroplan member who is not a Cardmember. The points reduction applies to any inbound or outbound origin and destination pairing when the corresponding outbound or inbound travel segment, is fully operated by Air Canada®, Air Canada Express®, or Air Canada Rouge® and booked through aircanada.comOpens Overlay, the Air Canada application, or the Air Canada call center. The reduction applies only to the points portion of the base fare of such eligible inbound or outbound origin and destination pairing of the flight reward and is not applicable for any taxes, fees, and charges (nor is it applicable to purchases offered by third-party partners, travel insurance, trip cancellation insurance, or Air Canada’s carbon offset program). The reduction cannot be applied to the cash portion of an Aeroplan flight reward. Cardmembers must be logged into their Aeroplan account which must be in good standing and linked to the eligible card at the time of booking. Gift cards and eCoupons can only be applied to the cash portion of the ticket. The Aeroplan account (including pooled accounts) must have sufficient points for the rewards redemption. Changes and cancellations follow Aeroplan Flight Reward Policy rules, and the Aeroplan member must remain an active primary Aeroplan Cardmember to be eligible for any future reductions to apply in the event of any changes to the booking. All Aeroplan Program terms and conditions apply. Chase is not responsible for the provision of, or failure to provide, the stated benefits.
Free First Checked Bags
You, as the primary cardmember, and up to eight (8) other passengers traveling on the same reservation (up to a maximum of nine (9) travelers), are each entitled to a free first checked bag up to 50lb. Benefit only applies when checking in with Air Canada, for a flight operated by Air Canada, Air Canada Rouge or under the Air Canada Express brand. Free first checked bag benefit is applicable only when the bag is checked in at the designated check-in counter, prior to security. Bags checked in at the gate are not eligible for this benefit. Benefit is not available if check-in is with another airline. If the first checked bag is already complimentary (for example, as a result of Aeroplan Elite Status or fare purchased), there is no additional checked bag benefit that will be provided. Free first checked bag benefit may not be applied retroactively, and no refunds will be issued. Service charges for additional/oversized/overweight baggage may apply. Chase is not responsible for the provision of, or failure to provide, the stated benefits. For more information on baggage restrictions, please visit aircanada.com/baggageOpens Overlay.
Over 1,300 Destinations: Number of destinations based on the published route networkOpens Overlay of Air Canada and its airline partners.
Flight Redemption: Taxes and third-party charges may apply. Based on Air Canada economy one-way short haul (up to 500 miles). For flight rewards including travel with a partner airline, a partner booking fee will apply. The number of Aeroplan points required for this destination might be higher, including for travel during high-demand periods and depending on travel itinerary. Seats subject to availability. Aeroplan points required for itineraries combining both Air Canada and partner airline flights may vary. Aeroplan points required for partner airline flight rewards are based on the actual distance flown between origin and destination. For full details please visit aircanada.com/ca/en/aco/home/aeroplan/legal/terms-and-conditions.htmlOpens Overlay.
Use Aeroplan® Points With Pay Yourself Back®: Aeroplan Points may be redeemed for a statement credit using Pay Yourself Back toward eligible purchases made with your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan card within 90 days from the purchase date. Categories, including promotional categories, eligible merchants, and purchase transaction eligibility may change from time to time. Redemption values will be shown on the transaction page prior to redemption. Redemption values may be changed at any time. We may apply a maximum amount of points you can use with Aeroplan points redemption with Pay Yourself Back from time to time. Statement credits will post to the card account within 3 business days of a request to redeem and will appear on the monthly Chase credit card billing statement within 6 to 8 weeks. Statement credits will reduce your balance, but you are still required to make at least your minimum monthly payment. Chase reserves the right to determine which purchases qualify for a statement credit. Only Aeroplan Points earned under the Aeroplan Program, the Air Canada Aeroplan Card, and Chase Ultimate Rewards® can be used for Chase Pay Yourself Back. Points converted from other programs are not eligible. For information about Chase rewards categories, see chase.com/RewardsCategoryFAQsOpens in a new window. If Aeroplan determines, in its sole discretion based on its data, that you have redeemed ineligible Aeroplan Points, Aeroplan reserves the right to reverse your point redemption or freeze your Aeroplan Membership account. You will be responsible for any balance on your credit card account resulting from a reversal.
Qualify for Aeroplan 35K Status:
Each calendar year you spend at least $75,000 in purchases on your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card account, you, as the primary cardmember, will be granted Aeroplan 35K Status for the remainder of that calendar year and for the next calendar year. Purchases are when you, or an authorized user, use the card to make purchases of products and services, minus returns or refunds. Buying products and services with your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card, in most cases, will count as a purchase; however, the following types of transactions won’t count as purchases: balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like transactions including, but not limited to: travelers checks, foreign currency, money orders, wire transfers, cryptocurrency, other similar digital or virtual currency and other similar transactions; lottery tickets, casino gaming chips, race track wagers, or similar offline and online betting transactions; person-to-person money transfers and account-funding transactions that transfer currency, any checks that access your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan account, interest, unauthorized or fraudulent charges, and fees of any kind, including an annual fee, if applicable. On January 1 of each calendar year, the spend calculation resets to zero and you must qualify again in that calendar year. Purchases made towards the end of a calendar year may not be posted to your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card account until the next calendar year and will therefore be included in the calculation for that calendar year. Please allow six (6) to eight (8) weeks after qualifying for Aeroplan 35K Status to be applied to your Aeroplan account. If you have earned a higher Aeroplan Elite status level through other means (under the Aeroplan Elite Status Terms and Conditions) you will retain the higher status. Aeroplan 35K Status and access to all associated features, benefits, services and amenities are subject to the Aeroplan Elite Status Terms and Conditions and are available at aircanada.com/elite-termsandconditionsOpens Overlay. Aeroplan 35K Status is non transferrable. Your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card account must be linked to your Aeroplan number and must be open and not in default, and your Aeroplan account must be in good standing to receive and retain Aeroplan 35K Status. Chase is not responsible for the provision of, or failure to provide, the stated benefits.
Annual Status Qualifying Credits
Each calendar year you are a primary cardmember of a Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card, you, as the primary cardmember, will receive 5,000 Status Qualifying Credits (SQC). The annual 5,000 SQC will be deposited to the primary cardmember’s Aeroplan account when the primary cardmember obtains a Chase Air Canada Aeroplan card and by the end of February in every year thereafter. An Aeroplan member is only eligible to receive one annual 5,000 SQC benefit in a calendar year regardless of the number of Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Cards they hold or open in that same calendar year. Any SQC that may be awarded in connection with any Aeroplan credit card, regardless of card issuer, including the Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card are subject to a combined maximum total of 25,000 SQC per Aeroplan Member per calendar year (the “Annual Credit Card Maximum”). If your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card account is closed, for any reason, any SQC awarded in that current Elite Year as a result of the annual SQC benefit will be removed from the Aeroplan account and Aeroplan Elite Status and benefits awarded in connection with this annual SQC benefit may also be reversed, revoked or rescinded. SQC are not redeemable towards Aeroplan rewards and only count towards Aeroplan Elite Status qualification. SQC cannot be exchanged and do not count towards Million Mile Status. Aeroplan reserves the right, at any time and at its sole discretion, to reverse, revoke or rescind SQC, Elite Status associated benefits in the event of misuse of this benefit. SQC and access to all associated features, benefits, services and amenities are subject to the Terms and Conditions of the Aeroplan Elite Status program and are available at aircanada.com/elite-termsandconditionsOpens Overlay. Your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card account must be linked to your Aeroplan number and must be open and not in default, and your Aeroplan account must be in good standing to receive the annual 5,000 SQC. Chase is not responsible for the provision of, or failure to provide, the stated benefits.
Collect Up to 20,000 Status Qualifying Credits
Each calendar year you are a primary cardmember of a Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card, you, as the primary cardmember, will receive 10,000 Status Qualifying Credits (SQC) once you spend $25,000 in purchases on your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card account in a calendar year, and an additional 10,000 SQC once you spend $50,000 in purchases on your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card account in a calendar year. Any SQC that may be awarded in connection with any Aeroplan credit card, regardless of issuer, including the Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card are subject to a combined maximum total of 25,000 SQC per Aeroplan Member, per calendar year (the “Annual Credit Card Maximum”). Purchases are when you, or an authorized user, use a card to make purchases of products and services, minus returns or refunds. Buying products and services with your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan card, in most cases, will count as a purchase; However, the following types of transactions won’t count as purchases: balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like transactions including, but not limited to: travelers checks, foreign currency, money orders, wire transfers, cryptocurrency, other similar digital or virtual currency and other similar transactions; lottery tickets, casino gaming chips, race track wagers, or similar offline and online betting transactions; person-to-person money transfers and account funding transactions that transfer currency, any checks that access your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card account, interest, unauthorized or fraudulent charges, and fees of any kind, including an annual fee, if applicable. On January 1 of each calendar year, the spend calculation resets to zero and you must spend in that year to accumulate SQC again in that year. Purchases made towards the end of a calendar year may not be posted to your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card account until the next calendar year and will therefore be included in the calculation for that calendar year. Please allow six (6) to eight (8) weeks after meeting the purchase thresholds for the SQC to be added to your Aeroplan account. SQC are not redeemable towards Aeroplan rewards and only count towards Aeroplan Elite Status qualification. SQC cannot be exchanged and do not count towards Million Mile Status. Aeroplan reserves the right, at any time and at its sole discretion, to reverse, revoke or rescind SQC, Elite Status associated benefits in the event of misuse of this benefit. SQC and access to all associated features, benefits, services and amenities are subject to the Terms and Conditions of the Aeroplan Elite Status program and are available at aircanada.com/elite-termsandconditionsOpens Overlay. Your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan Card account must be linked to your Aeroplan number and must be open and not in default, and your Aeroplan account must be in good standing at the time of processing and fulfillment. Chase is not responsible for the provision of, or failure to provide, the stated benefits.
Global Entry or TSA PreCheck® or NEXUS Application Fee Statement Credit
You will receive one statement credit every four years (up to $120) after the first program (either Global Entry or TSA PreCheck® or NEXUS) application fee is charged to your Chase Air Canada Aeroplan® Card, by you or an authorized user. This benefit applies only to the Global Entry, TSA PreCheck® or NEXUS programs, other Trusted Traveler Programs are not eligible. Only purchases made directly with the U.S. Department of Homeland Security, eligible partner listed on ttp.cbp.dhs.gov/ Opens overlay, or authorized enrollment providers featured on tsa.gov/precheck Opens overlay website are eligible for reimbursement. Purchases made through any third parties, such as travel agencies or application assistance services, are not eligible for reimbursement. The statement credit will appear on your credit card billing statement within 1-2 billing cycles. You are responsible for payment of all charges until the statement credit posts to the account. Chase has no control or liability regarding these programs including, but not limited to, applications, approval process or enrollment, or fees charged by CBP or TSA or DHS. For more information about the Global Entry, TSA PreCheck® and NEXUS programs, including application details and full terms and conditions, go to ttp.cbp.dhs.gov/ Opens overlay. Websites and other information provided by government agencies are not within Chase's control and may not be available in Spanish. To receive statement credits, your account must be open and not in default at the time of fulfillment.
TSA PreCheck® is a registered trademark and is used with the permission of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security.
Concierge Service: Cardmembers are responsible for the cost of any goods or services purchased through World Mastercard Concierge.
Zero Liability: Zero Liability Protection does not apply to use of an account by an authorized user without the approval of the primary cardmember. If you think someone used your account without permission, tell us immediately by calling the Cardmember Services number on your card or billing statement.
Account Alerts: Delivery of alerts may be delayed for various reasons including technology failures and capacity limitations. There is no charge from Chase, but message and data rates may apply.
Cardmembers Eligible for Chase Pay Over Time: Eligible cardmembers are those with access to Chase Pay Over Time who use a participating Chase credit card for eligible purchases. Access to Chase Pay Over Time is not guaranteed, is based on a variety of factors such as creditworthiness, credit limit and account behavior, and may change from time to time. Participating Credit Cards for Chase Pay Over Time After Purchase: Participating Chase credit cards include most consumer credit cards and select small business credit cards. For a complete list of participating Chase credit cards, see “Which Chase credit cards are eligible to use Chase Pay Over Time after a purchase is made” at chase.com/personal/credit-cards/chasepayovertime/faqs/after-purchaseOpens in a new window. Participating Credit Cards for Chase Pay Over Time at checkout on Amazon.com: Participating Chase credit cards include all credit cards except small business credit cards, Amazon Visa and Prime Visa cards, and Chase Mastercard credit cards.
Purchases Eligible for Chase Pay Over Time Set Up After Purchase: Purchases of at least $100 are eligible, excluding certain transactions such as (a) cash-like transactions, (b) any fees owed to us, including Annual Membership Fees, and (c) purchases made under a separate promotion or special finance program. Eligible purchases will be identified within your transaction history on chase.comOpens in a new window or the Chase Mobile App.
Complimentary DashPass: When the membership is activated for the first time with your eligible Chase card between 02/01/2025 and 12/31/2027, you will receive 12 months of complimentary DashPass for use on both the DoorDash and Caviar applications during the same membership period based on the first activation date. After the complimentary DashPass membership period ends, you will continue to be enrolled and will be automatically charged the then-current monthly DashPass rate (plus applicable tax) on a recurring monthly basis for each membership activated until you cancel. You can cancel anytime on DoorDash or Caviar. The same log in credentials must be used on DoorDash and Caviar in order for the DashPass benefit to be used on both applications. To receive the membership benefits, the cardmember must first add their applicable Chase credit card as a default payment method on DoorDash or Caviar, and then click the activation button. Once enrolled in DashPass, you must use your eligible Chase card for payment at checkout for DashPass-eligible orders to receive DashPass benefits. DashPass benefits apply only to eligible orders from DashPass-eligible merchants that meet the minimum subtotal requirement (as stated in the DoorDash and Caviar apps and sites with amounts subject to change). However, other fees (including service fee), taxes, and gratuity on orders may apply. Current value of the DashPass membership is as of 02/01/2025. DashPass orders are subject to delivery driver and geographic availability. Membership must be activated with a United States address. Payment through third-party payment accounts, or online or mobile digital wallets (like Apple Pay and Google Wallet), or memberships purchased through third parties are excluded from this offer. If you product change to another Chase credit card during the promotional period, your benefits may change. You may experience a delay in updating your applicable benefits on DoorDash or Caviar; please note, once you product trade, the benefits from your previous credit card are no longer available for your use. You can only access the benefits available with your current credit card. Mobile applications, websites and other information provided by DoorDash or Caviar are not within Chase’s control and may or may not be available in Spanish. Chase is not responsible for the provision of, or the failure to provide, DoorDash or Caviar benefits and services. Your applicable Chase credit card account must be open and not in default to maintain membership benefits. See full DoorDash terms and conditions at: https://help.doordash.com/consumers/s/article/offer-terms-conditions?language=en_USOpens overlay.
Earn Up to $10 Off Monthly or Quarterly on DoorDash Non-Restaurant Orders: Once you have activated your DashPass membership for the first time between 09/01/2026 and 12/31/2027, you will receive a $10 off discount each calendar month at checkout on one qualifying non-restaurant order on DoorDash as long as you remain enrolled in a DashPass membership. If you activated your DashPass membership between 02/01/2025 and 08/31/2026, you will receive a $10 off discount each calendar quarter at checkout on one qualifying non-restaurant order on DoorDash as long as you remain enrolled in a DashPass membership. Please visit your Manage DashPass page to check when you activated your DashPass membership and confirm which discount applies to your account. Discount applies to subtotal only; does not apply to fees, taxes, and gratuity. Fees, taxes, and gratuity still apply. To claim, select the discount from the promotion wallet at checkout, or claim the discount when prompted in the DoorDash app or website. If the full $10 value is not used on a single order, the remaining value will be forfeited.
